message.content: Sally J. Lieber (D) is the researched candidate for District 2 Member of the California State Board of Equalization in the November 2026 general election; no other candidate has a recorded comparison. On antisemitism-education legislation, she supports implementing AB 715 and SB 48 and strongly opposes weakening them. A 2024 CAIR Action guide described her as an outspoken supporter of a ceasefire and Palestinian rights, and she calls Israel a safe haven and the United States' one true ally in the region. CAIR Action endorsed her in the general phase, and Vote for Peace supported her with an Ally rating. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel as a democratic, inclusive, and secure Jewish state, endorsed her in the primary with that endorsement carried forward to the general. Muslim Dems and Friends of Alameda County and Congressman Ro Khanna also endorsed her. Documented independent spending in her support totals $7,170.75 from GROWSF Voter Guide, California Working Families Party, the Contra Costa County Democratic Party, the Conejo Valley Democratic Club, and the California Teachers Association, all with unestablished issue relevance.
